descriptions.core: Ashvale is a tactical adventure about a courier crossing a storm-scarred valley to reconnect isolated settlements.

features: Navigate a storm-scarred valley connected by old trade roads.
Plan encounters around weather and terrain.
Reconnect settlements by restoring damaged relay towers.
Discover local stories through letters and abandoned camps.
Customize the courier's route and equipment.

history_and_inspiration.history: Ashvale began as a prototype about route planning before expanding into a tactical adventure.
history_and_inspiration.inspiration: The team drew inspiration from mountain trade routes, travel journals and changing weather.

quote.text: Every road in Ashvale should feel like a decision worth remembering.
quote.attribution: Ira Sen, Creative Director, Copper Lantern

coverage.headline: Ashvale turns route planning into an adventure
